comparability: The reviewed cases use compact orthographic product views with source-specific dimensions and restrained annotation.
The manufacturer cases cover both U-bolt drawing conventions and every distinct one-side structural blind-fastener mechanism displayed by the handbook.
physical_relationships_learned: Reference envelopes must remain visually distinct from the supplied product.
Blind-fastener components and pre-installation geometry vary by manufacturer and must not be represented by one generic mechanism.
adopted_patterns: Use one orthographic manufacturer-specific product-reference view in Selected product.
Use restrained metallic shading to distinguish the supplied product from reference geometry while preserving source dimensions and component boundaries.
Use the pinned local Lato regular face for general dimensions and component callouts; do not synthesize intermediate font weights.
Define shared SVG paint resources once at document level so hidden product branches cannot shadow the active product view.
Report catalogue grip ranges as structured data or caption text; do not draw a range as a fixed dimension without verified physical endpoints.
Retain manufacturer dimension symbols where published and define any concise handbook abbreviation in the accessible description.
Keep product, reference, dimension and label layers semantically separate.
important_differences: SC Handbook is a responsive catalogue lookup, not a drawing sheet or installation instruction.
The selected-product card intentionally excludes installed, expanded and locked states.
Each catalogue row may provide a different subset of verified dimensions.
not_copied: No dimensions are inferred from raster scale or transferred between manufacturers.
No copyrighted manufacturer artwork, installation sequence or proprietary internal geometry is copied.
No foreign-jurisdiction design value is treated as Australian design authority.
